named_method: Reproduction-style comparative analysis of LambdaCDM, EDE, and w0wa constraints using provided summary data
definition: Use the supplied structured reproduction data as the primary quantitative source
Preserve model-specific parameter sets rather than collapsing into pooled summaries
Compare shared cosmological parameters across models
Report EDE-specific parameters f_EDE and log10_ac explicitly
Provide model-comparison or fit-quality discussion tied to available evidence
Include distance-comparison visualization for DESI BAO and Union3 SNe extracted points
assumptions: Raw likelihood chains are unavailable in the workspace
Goodness-of-fit values may need to be sourced from related work text if present; otherwise must be reported as unavailable
invariants: Do not claim exact posterior reconstruction from summary points alone
Keep source-specific artifacts for DESI BAO and Union3 SNe data
State limitations if Delta chi^2 values are not recoverable from workspace artifacts
non_negotiable_structural_steps: Write a validation section separating direct workspace evidence from related-work context
